turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good topic. We use am/is/are + verb-ing for things that are happening now.
Two children are playing football. A man is sitting under a tree.
Tip: don't forget is or are! ("The boy is running", not "The boy running".)

Imagine a park right now. Write two sentences about what people are doing.
